title: Final Ratio Answer
description: Essential: The response must provide the correct numerical ratio of the accelerations after collision to before collision (9/16).

title: Pre-Collision Force
description: Important: The solution must correctly apply Coulomb's law to calculate the initial electrostatic force using the given charges (8q and -2q).

title: Post-Collision Charge
description: Important: The solution must correctly apply charge conservation to find the equal charge on each sphere after they make contact (3q).

title: Post-Collision Force
description: Important: The solution must correctly apply Coulomb's law to calculate the electrostatic force after the collision using the new equal charges (3q and 3q).

title: Acceleration Ratio Derivation
description: Important: The solution must correctly relate force to acceleration via Newton's second law and form the ratio, showing cancellation of common constants (k, m, l).

title: Sign Ignorance Error
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student incorrectly uses the sign of the charges in the magnitude calculation of the Coulomb force (e.g., using -8q*2q).

title: Charge Sharing Mistake
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student makes an error in calculating the shared charge after contact (e.g., averaging incorrectly or forgetting they are identical).
